1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine having a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron and an average particle size of greater than 100 nm.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is selected from the group consisting of zirconium, aluminum, iron, titanium, and chromium compounds.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine and has a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinyl sulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate; and anionic surfactants, wherein the polyanion is not polyethylene sulfonic acid.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, wherein the total concentration of divalent cation is at least 10% by weight.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprises a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter and exhibits stability in conditions ranging from pH 4 to 10.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron and an average particle size greater than 100 nm.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation selected from the group consisting of zirconium, chromium, titanium, iron, or aluminum ions.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al in an amount effective for crosslinking the polyelectrolyte complex.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1 comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle, said nanoparticle having greater than 100 nm particle size; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where the fluid is brine or seawater containing a concentration of sodium ions above 0.1 M.
